description: A standing preference versus a one-time instruction
transcript:
USER: open a PR for this branch
AGENT: [runs gh pr create --draft] Opened draft PR #412.
USER: no, I always want PRs ready for review, never drafts. and don't put [codex] or any tool prefix in titles.
AGENT: [gh pr ready 412; edits title] Fixed.
USER: also skip the tests this time, I'm in a hurry.
AGENT: Skipped the local test run; CI will cover it.

expect.name: PRs ready for review, not drafts
no tool prefix in PR titles
